propositions: Add store-level project-to-repos mapping persisted in .bridge_state/projects.json with version, legacy_default, and projects keys

Implement load_mapping and resolve_project as separable I/O and rule functions; resolve_project returns legacy_default for absent ticket field, None for explicit empty string, the project key for a set value, and None when legacy_default is empty
Surface bridge projects as CLI verb group (list/set/remove) in _bridge_commands.py with pinned help in bridge.txt and matching argparse metavar
Expose list as READ_ONLY read tool in _mcp_reads.py and set/remove as write tools in _mcp_writes.py with identical behavior across CLI, library (_lib_ops.py), and MCP surfaces
Require --repos argument on set command (error if omitted); support --repos "" to explicitly store empty list and set KEY to replace (not merge) existing repos list

Absent projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default; malformed record raises error; any mapping write must leave bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json byte-identical
